release_notes: Restored the matching `better-sqlite3` native dependency removed during the prior failed rebuild.
Made Godot test/build scripts create writable temporary cache, config, and data directories automatically.
Changed the API integration test to exercise authentication and multipart submission in-process without requiring loopback sockets.
Preserved the 5×5 square-grid release, connected recipe merging, readable UI, fullscreen control, redraws, and combo scoring.
